transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Uh, yeah… I guess the main thing that pushed me to come in is my eating’s been kind of inconsistent. I mean, it’s probably not a huge deal, but some days I’ll just forget to eat meals, and then other nights I’m up late, like after midnight, going through takeout or snacks. It’s been all over the place, and it kind of scared me a little, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah… mostly my appetite, I guess. I haven’t really been tracking my weight or anything, so I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but my eating’s been pretty uneven. Like some days I’ll just forget to eat meals completely, and then other nights I’m up past midnight tearing through takeout or snacks. It’s kind of embarrassing, honestly.
Do you find yourself eating a lot in a short amount of time, like feeling like you’re consuming a large amount in one sitting, especially during those late-night eating episodes?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but sometimes at night it does feel like I’m eating a lot all at once. Like after midnight I’ll end up tearing through takeout or snacks, and then other days I’ll barely eat or just forget meals completely. It’s been kind of all over the place, honestly, and that’s what scared me enough to come in.
When you’re eating a lot in one sitting, especially at night, do you feel like you can’t control how much you’re eating or stop yourself from continuing to eat?

I mean… I’m not sure I’d say I totally can’t stop myself, exactly. It’s more like once it’s late and I start eating, I kind of keep going through the takeout or snacks before I really think about it. And then I feel weird about it after. Some days I’ve forgotten meals completely, so maybe that’s part of it? I don’t know if that answers it the right way.
Has your eating behavior been causing you a lot of distress or affecting your daily life in any way, like at work, school, or with relationships?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say it’s ruining everything or anything. But it has been bothering me, honestly. The eating being so all over the place is part of what made me think I should come in—like some days I just forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout and snacks. It feels embarrassing, and it kind of throws me off the next day. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Can you describe what typically happens during those late-night eating episodes? Specifically, do you tend to eat most of it in a short amount of time?

Yeah… usually it’s pretty late, like after midnight, and I’ll start with takeout or whatever snacks are around. I don’t know if I’d call it, like, a “binge” exactly, but I do kind of tear through a lot of it before I realize how much I’ve eaten.

Then other days it’s the opposite and I’ll just forget meals completely, so it feels really inconsistent. That’s honestly part of what scared me into coming in. Is that what you mean by in a short amount of time?
During those late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you’re on autopilot or that you can’t control the urge to eat, even if you know you don’t need to eat that much?

Kind of, yeah… I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it feels like once it’s after midnight and I start with takeout or snacks, I’m not really thinking it through. I just keep eating, and then afterward I’m like, “Why did I do that?”

It’s confusing because some days I’ll forget meals completely, so the whole eating thing has just been really all over the place. That’s honestly part of what scared me into coming in. Does that make sense?
When you’re eating during those late-night episodes, do you find yourself eating much faster than usual?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t really sit there and, like, savor it or anything. It’s more like I’m just tearing through the takeout or snacks, especially after midnight, and then I kind of realize after the fact how much I had.

I mean, some days I barely remember to eat at all, so maybe that’s part of why it happens, but… yeah, during those nights it probably is faster than normal.
During those late-night eating episodes, do you find yourself eating until you're uncomfortably full?

Yeah… I mean, sometimes I probably do. I don’t want to make it sound like every time, but on those nights after midnight when I’m going through takeout or snacks, I’ll keep eating past the point where I really need to.

Then other days I’ll forget meals completely, so it’s just been all over the place. Honestly, that’s the part that scared me into coming in… like, it doesn’t feel very steady or normal.
Do you usually find yourself eating at night because you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset about something?

I mean… maybe sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s always because I’m stressed or upset exactly. The main thing is just my eating has been really all over the place.

Like some days I’ll forget meals completely, and then other nights, especially after midnight, I’m kind of tearing through takeout or snacks. That’s honestly what scared me into coming in, because it just doesn’t feel normal for me. Does that answer what you mean?
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food even when you’re not physically hungry, especially during those late-night episodes?

Yeah… I guess I do sometimes. I don’t think I’m always actually hungry when it happens, if I’m being honest.

It’s more like my eating’s just been all over the place lately—some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights, especially after midnight, I’ll kind of tear through takeout or snacks. That’s the part that made me think, okay, maybe I should talk to someone about it. Does that make sense?
Can you recall if during those late-night eating episodes you feel a clear loss of control, like you’re unable to stop eating or regulate how much you consumes once you start?

I don’t know if I’d call it totally unable to stop, but… yeah, it can feel like I’m not regulating it very well once I start.

It’s embarrassing to say, but that’s kind of the thing that scared me into coming in—my eating’s been all over the place. Some days I’ll just forget meals, and then other nights after midnight I’m tearing through takeout or snacks. I know that probably sounds bad, but I’m trying to be honest.
Can you tell me if during those late-night eating episodes, you eat a definitely larger amount of food than most people would eat in a similar period of time?

I mean… probably sometimes, yeah. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but on those nights after midnight I can go through a lot of takeout or snacks in one sitting.

It’s not like every single night, but compared to how I eat normally—or how I think most people would—it does feel like more than it should be. I guess that’s part of what scared me into coming in.
How often do these late-night eating episodes happen? Like, would you say they occur at least once a week most weeks?

Yeah… I think most weeks it’s at least once, if I’m being honest. I don’t want to overstate it, because it’s not like every night or anything, but the pattern’s been there.

Some days I barely eat or forget meals, and then other nights—usually late, after midnight—I end up going through takeout or snacks. That back-and-forth is what made me feel like maybe it wasn’t normal and I should come in.
